interpretation_guardrails: No single aggregate similarity score is computed.
Plug-in entropy and raw token MI are sample-size sensitive.
Control source line boundaries are edition/layout boundaries, not claimed equivalents of Voynich manuscript loci.
Metadata-specific Voynich constraints such as Currier, scribe, and section cannot be evaluated on generic plaintext cipher controls.
The benchmark reads Voynich TRAIN Tier-0 results only; validation and locked test are not required.
